newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea LG Semicon IPO 26.52 times subscribed - lead.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea LG Semicon IPO 26.52 times subscribed - lead.

text.p: The 10 million share initial public offering by South Korean chipmaker LG Semicon Co, a unit of the LG Group, was 26.52 times subscribed, lead manager Hyundai Securities said on Friday.
A Hyundai official said applications for 260.52 million shares came in during the Wednesday-Thursday subscription period.
Deadline for payment is October 5 and the shares are scheduled to be listed on the Seoul stock market on November 9, she said.
The shares are offered at 20,000 won per share.
LG Semicon is one of South Korea's top three semiconductor makers.
